I love this story so much that I never want it to end.

I am completely obsessed with Kishiyu, I love how the relationships and interactions unfold, both among the main characters and the supporting cast, and I greatly admire the author for writing such a long novel without it ever becoming boring, all while maintaining the reader's attention and keeping the narrative thread intact.
Sometimes I think it wouldn't be so bad to have my memory wiped, just so I could read this all over again as if for the very first time 😅

I am so grateful for the recommendation that got me started on this novel, I have absolutely no regrets. I love the author's writing style and the way they convey ideas, stories, and emotions. I also find the art of the novel beautiful, and I’m eagerly looking forward to the upcoming volumes and any future illustrations that might be released.

I hope everything turns out well in the end. This story really excites me and even though I haven't reached the final chapters yet, and still have a long way to go, I’m already completely hooked. I highly recommend it! 🖤💛
